go-latitude-llm v0.1.2

- Expanded and clarified the skill manifest and documentation, including endpoint discovery, method signatures, and usage of Go doc tools.
- Moved license and homepage fields to the manifest root and added user-invocable flag.
- Updated security and usage sections for greater clarity.
- Removed skill-card.md.

- Removed the file skill-card.md.
- No changes to functionality or documentation in SKILL.md.

Initial release of go-latitude-llm.

- Provides an unofficial, typed Go client for the Latitude LLM ops platform (latitude.so).
- Supports projects, traces, scores, annotations, saved searches, issues, API keys, and organization management.
- Emphasizes security best practices: no hardcoded credentials, careful logging, and use of environment variables.
- Details limitations, recommended usage scenarios, and safety guidelines.
- Offers method and usage guidance specific to the generated Go client.
